    WHERE A.OutstandingInvestmentFull != 0

    WHERE A.AUMAmountFull > 0

--DEP records with TRU and TRY
WITH test AS (
SELECT B.BranchID, C.CustomerType, A.* FROM dw.DimCustomerAccount A
    LEFT JOIN dw.DimBranch B ON A.BranchSK = B.BranchSK
    LEFT JOIN dw.DimCustomer C ON A.CustomerSK = C.CustomerSK
    WHERE A.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND B.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND A.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
    AND A.CustomerSK IN (
    SELECT CustomerSK FROM dw.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment A LEFT JOIN dw.DimCustomerAccount B ON A.AccountID = B.AccountID
        WHERE A.OutstandingInvestmentFull != 0 AND B.CurrentIndicator = 1
        GROUP BY CustomerSK    
    )
    AND A.CustomerSK IN (
    SELECT CustomerSK FROM dw.FactTrustFundValue A LEFT JOIN dw.DimCustomerAccount B ON A.AccountID = B.AccountID
        WHERE A.AUMAmountFull > 0 AND B.CurrentIndicator = 1
        GROUP BY CustomerSK  
    )  
)

    FROM DW.CI_Deposits_Retail CDR
    JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON CDR.AccountId = DA.AccountId

    GROUP BY FCBSCIF

,CI_Trust_Retail AS ( 
    SELECT FCBSCIF 
    ---,SUM(AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Full) AS AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Full  
    ,SUM(AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Prorated) AS AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Prorated  
    FROM DW.CI_Trust_Retail  
    GROUP BY FCBSCIF  
)
,CI_Treasury_Retail AS ( 
    SELECT FCBSCIF 
    ---,SUM(OutstandingInvestmentFull) AS OutstandingInvestment_Full  
    ,SUM(OutstandingInvestmentProrated) AS OutstandingInvestment_Shared  
    FROM DW.CI_Treasury_Retail  
    GROUP BY FCBSCIF  
)
